assets.name: terrain
assets.prompt: Create a premium game tactical-map terrain texture for a modern Korean metropolitan faction war UI. Orthographic straight top-down, NO perspective tilt. A continuous detailed urban region: small dense charcoal slate city blocks and networks of softly illuminated narrow ivory/teal roads, industrial blocks, quieter wooded hills and fine topographic relief toward outskirts. Polished high-end strategy game map, restrained desaturated graphite/blue-green palette, visible road hierarchy, gentle relief shadows, tiny amber street light accents. Clear mid-dark value range, texture readable behind pale map labels. The texture will be clipped underneath exact administrative SVG boundaries, so NO province boundaries, NO labels, NO characters, NO city names, NO lettering, NO symbols, NO UI panels, NO giant hero buildings, NO strong colored faction patches, NO space/neon sci-fi. Wide landscape composition 3:2, seamless continuous terrain extending to edges. Not a finished interface, only a finely crafted game terrain image.

assets.name: clash
assets.prompt: Create ONE transparent game map marker for a contemporary Korean organization territory war. Two crossed short brushed-steel combat blades striking at the center with a concentrated warm amber impact spark, a few small red-orange ember streaks and wisps of dark smoke. Strong compact silhouette readable at 48 pixels; complete blades and handles with breathing room; metallic silver edges with amber reflection, charcoal handles. Premium painted 2D game UI asset, restrained and crisp, no shield, no enclosing disk, no ornamental frame, no text, no letters, no background rectangle. All surrounding area true transparent alpha. Square composition. It will be used as the animated ACTIVE combat pin on a dark tactical city map.
